query: Tucker Carlson new third party FEC Form 1 Statement of Organization filing July August 2026 status
answer:
I've completed the research. Here's the summary of my findings:

## Tucker Carlson Third Party — FEC Form 1 Filing Status (July–August 2026)

**Bottom line: No FEC Form 1 (Statement of Organization) has been filed for a Tucker Carlson third party as of the research date (July 25, 2026).** The effort remains an announcement of intent — no party name, no committee, no timeline, no organizational filings.

**Key findings:**
- In a *Columbia Journalism Review* interview published ~July 1–3, 2026, Carlson said "I'm going to help build a third party" after breaking with the GOP over U.S./Israel–Iran policy.
- He explicitly stated he will **not** be a candidate.
- Multiple outlets (NOTUS, TIME, Forbes, Washington Times, Philadelphia Inquirer) confirm the plan is "conceptual," with no party name and no FEC filing mentioned.
- FEC committee-database searches found no legitimate Carlson-linked party/committee (one superficially matching PAC, C00955997, is unrelated).
- No news coverage was found from late July or August 2026 indicating any escalation to an actual filing.

**Caveats:** Reporting clusters tightly around July 1–3, 2026, and no newer coverage was found. AskNews news/X tools were unavailable due to tier restrictions, so I relied on web search and direct source reads. A fully definitive negative would require a live FEC.gov committee-search confirmation, which could not be exhaustively queried in real time.

I've provided the full structured findings via the StructuredOutput tool.

Carlson announced intent to 'help build a third party' in a Columbia Journalism Review interview published ~July 1-3, 2026, after breaking with the GOP over U.S./Israel-Iran policy.
As of early-to-mid July 2026, no party name, timeline, committee, or organizational steps had been announced; reporting characterized the plan as 'conceptual.'
Carlson explicitly stated he does NOT want to be a candidate for any such new party.
FEC committee-database searches returned no legitimate Carlson-linked party or committee; a superficially matching PAC (C00955997) is unrelated novelty filing.
No news coverage found from late July or August 2026 indicating any escalation to an actual FEC filing.
FEC Form 1 must be filed within 10 days of a committee's establishment; electronic filing is required if receipts/expenditures exceed or are expected to exceed $50,000 in a calendar year.
